fee_notes: Royalty: greater of 6% weekly gross sales or $150/week for traditional; 6% with no minimum for non-traditional; LA Fitness locations pay flat $750/month (3% annual increase). Advertising: currently 0.5% of weekly gross sales (max 4%); Blimpie/Walmart co-branded NrGize: 2%; LA Fitness locations: 0%. Data/tech fee up to $75/month. POS help desk $55/month.
